title: The I and C figure in the gear worn now: the rifle at the ready, or hanging from the hand
about: Your words of 2026-11-15: "the I and C menu preview of the character should show the currently worn gear". The figure is the game's own doll, dressed from what you wear and carry (the gear record, src/sim/arms/gear.js): the combat EVA suit drawn at last (v0.0.17 drew the utilities under it), the plate carrier with a baseplate showing for each magazine in a pouch, the dump pouch on the belt, the P-12 in its thigh holster (its grip over the mouth, or the mouth open with the pistol drawn) and its spare in the pouch below, the R-7 slung front, on the back, or in the hands, ear defenders' cups where they are worn. Each figure at the I and C cards' scale, unlit as the cards draw it, labelled. Score R: how the rifle in the hands is drawn. Shot first in v0.0.23 (drawn at R-a since v0.0.18 with nobody's score behind it); where it meets v0.0.23's sets: R-b, the rifle hanging from the hand, is `portrait-gun`'s W2, so one score decides both (the portrait's holds grow from it: R-a is the hold `rifle-low`).

groups.title: R: the rifle in the hands on the doll
groups.about: R-a both hands at the low ready as a marine holds it, the butt in the right shoulder's pocket, the rifle down across the body toward the ground ahead of the left foot, the right hand at the grip, the left on the handguard (redrawn in v0.0.24 on your word of 2026-11-19, "The Doll is wrong, nobody holds their gun like that": v0.0.18 to v0.0.23 drew it at the hip, 35° below level). R-b the rifle hanging from the right hand, muzzle down, as v0.0.17's board man held it. Each view: you at GO in the shoot house, after Transition (the P-12 at the ready, the R-7 slung front), the R-7 slung on the back, your #2 (no P-12), and the range kit on the utilities with ear defenders and a magazine in the left hand.

R-b: hanging from the right hand

groups.title: P: the magazines in the pouches (for reference)
groups.about: VIEWS §4.2's rule as written: a double magazine pouch shows two baseplates when full and one when half, an empty one only its seam; the dump pouch sags by what it holds. Chest pouches 1 and 2 from empty to full, then the dump pouch with none, two and four.
